prompt:
Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Lessons from earlier weeks:
Bypassing onboarding steps directly (new_flow) significantly improves user conversion.
Reordering friction by moving sign-in after pet selection (reorder) significantly improves conversion.
Copy improvements, permission checks during setup, and layout changes showed no clear effect.
Predictions consistently overestimated actual measured gains across all tests.

Measured so far, by kind of change (relative change on the target step):
- adoption, new_flow: +10.4% over 1 test(s)
- choose_path, layout: -0.2% over 1 test(s)
- finish, copy: +5.9% over 1 test(s)
- home, wait_info: +0.5% over 1 test(s)
- sign_in, reorder: +7.0% over 1 test(s)

Funnel:
- choose_path: 76.2%, median 8s / mean 514s
- sign_in: 76.1%, median 3s / mean 567s
- adoption: 69.3%, median 89s / mean 1017s
- home: 81.3%, median 201s / mean 2336s
- finish: 64.8%, median 395s / mean 5815s
- finishing onboarding overall: 21.2%

Return JSON {"scores": [{"index": i, "impact": n, "evidence": n, "confidence": n, "cost": n,
"predicted_lift": x, "note": short}]}

Changes:
0: [finish, redesign] Desktop pet launchpad redesign: Redesign the home intro step into a spotlight layout with an instant pet spawn preview and quick desktop control keys. (why: Finish conversion is 64.8% and median time is long (395s); users also complain about desktop features misbehaving or unclear controls.)
1: [finish, new_screen] Pet care orientation screen: Insert a new orientation screen before completing onboarding that demonstrates desktop controls and pet interaction. (why: Support receives multiple tickets regarding unclear pet controls and desktop feature misbehavior (7 emails total).)
2: [home, notification] Generation status notification on wait screen: Add system notification prompt on the waiting screen to alert users when pet creation finishes if the app is minimized. (why: Waiting stage mean time is 2336s and users drop off or experience app stalls.)
3: [home, wait_info] Real-time generation wait progress tips: Display animated pet tips and time estimates on the waiting screen while pet files compile in the background. (why: The waiting step home has a mean duration of 2336s; keeping users engaged with tips reduces abandonment.)
4: [sign_in, hint] Account recovery safety hint on sign-in: Add a visible account persistence hint on the sign-in screen informing users how pets sync across re-logins. (why: 8 support emails reported lost or reset pets after signing back into their accounts.)
5: [choose_path, copy] Simplified path selection guidance: Simplify path selection text with clear, direct headlines emphasizing fast setup versus custom creation. (why: Path selection takes a mean of 514s; clear copy speeds up choice decision.)

scores.note: Target step loses ~35% of users with clear support and time evidence, but layout redesigns have shown no clear effect in past tests.
Addresses 7 support tickets, but adding a new screen increases friction, contradicting lessons on simplifying flows.
Addresses extreme mean wait duration (2336s) by re-engaging minimized users via push notifications.
Directly tested previously as home wait_info with only a +0.5% relative gain.
Low cost update backed by 8 support emails, though copy changes historically yield negligible measured lift.
Easy config change addressing 514s duration, but copy improvements have shown no clear impact.
